title: Prepared nasal dose logging with verified exact-bottle inventory and protected UI

changes.title: Log prepared nasal sprays using the exact verified bottle
changes.detail: Enable nasal dose review and confirmation on eligible prepared stock; atomically record an administration, exact bottle balance and source ledger, and offer exact-source Undo without debiting the original vial twice.

changes.title: Protected cross-tab nasal inventory persistence
changes.detail: All prepared spray administrations and reversals use the shared exclusive writer, canonical saved snapshot, stale-tab refusal, write-readback verification and no speculative success on storage failure.

changes.title: Retain approved search, calculator and backed-dose corrections
changes.detail: Preserve PR146 single clear-X search, injectable syringe overflow recovery and read-only theoretical nasal calculator, alongside PR142 backed-dose history/writer reliability.

dataImpact: No destructive migration, import, automatic rewrite, or overwrite of existing production localStorage (peptide-tracker-html-v1). Only explicitly confirmed eligible LIVE prepared-nasal administrations atomically add the dose and exact-bottle ledger transaction and debit that prepared bottle; verified Undo reverses the same original event. Original physical source vials must not be deducted again. Other existing history, protocols, Check-Ins, Stash and inventory remain untouched. DEMO remains isolated.
limitations: Prepared-dose use delegates to the established prepared-syringe confirmation flow; unsupported administration-method and multi-source combinations fail closed rather than inventing new physical transactions.

The prepared nasal administration gate is ON only in this unmerged release candidate, not on deployed production. Generic preparation transfers remain OFF. Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, and independent clinical pump calibration acceptance remain pending.

The full offline DEMO intentionally uses fallback fonts. LIVE source preserves external DM Sans/Fraunces/DM Mono import; actual online font-file rendering and VoiceOver/Dynamic Type were not independently accepted in this release session.
Automated vial-source and measurement regressions passed; synthetic calculator diagnostics do not establish independent clinical certification.
Product UI reviewed through user-provided iPhone screenshots and user approval; no separate physical VoiceOver audit is claimed.
Release metadata is reconciled after merge; app source parity was independently verified at squash merge fe51ace9 before metadata publication.
